At GTC on March 18, 2025, Nvidia unveiled Blackwell Ultra as its near-term AI chip upgrade and laid out the roadmap for Rubin, its next generation. (investor.nvidia.com)
Blackwell Ultra: Nvidia said partner systems such as the GB300 NVL72 would be available in the second half of 2025. The upgrade offered more computing power and up to 288 GB of high-bandwidth memory per GPU, aimed at speeding up AI training and running reasoning models. (investor.nvidia.com)
Vera Rubin: Nvidia said systems pairing the new Rubin GPU with the Vera CPU were planned for the second half of 2026, with Rubin Ultra to follow in the second half of 2027. (nvidia.com)
Later, on September 9, 2025, Nvidia also announced Rubin CPX, a specialized GPU for processing very long inputs in workloads like coding and video generation. It was expected at the end of 2026. (nvidianews.nvidia.com)
